diagnosis.summary: Dev Root 44952879415 installed Chromium v1255 and passed CLI readiness (exit 0). The immutable 13-response archived baseline matches its approved SHA256 (ee11d9c28f52d862955255cd9ac08b70a6915fcf003417559b4fcb45aff0618d) and contains 12 frozen /bff/strategies captures (including page_size=5, page_size=50, page_size=20&page_token=20, per-persona, and hide_retired_personas=true&page_size=20) plus 1 /bff/management/data-sources capture. Its original keys never included standalone /bff/strategies?page_size=20, which belongs exclusively to the live 10-sample default_first_page timing loop. validateInput() in scripts/accept-persona-strategy-hosted-readonly.mjs falsely required paths.includes(DEFAULT_PAGE_PATH) in the frozen baseline dictionary and exited with code 2 before launching the browser. Neither the workflow nor the protected supplementary publisher was the source of the parser failure.
diagnosis.changed_invariant: Removed only paths.includes(DEFAULT_PAGE_PATH) from validateInput() in scripts/accept-persona-strategy-hosted-readonly.mjs while retaining paths.includes(HIDE_RETIRED_PATH) because hide_retired_without_state timing is read from responses[HIDE_RETIRED_PATH].ms.
diagnosis.unchanged_owners: Existing CLI invocation contract, protected supplementary publisher, private archived baseline file, product features, runtime/auth, credentials, workflows, and deployment scope remain untouched.
